question: The process by which electorates remove elected official is called_________
explanation: The power of impeachment belongs to the legislature to check the Executive act of gross misconduct while Re-call is exercisable within the reach of the electorates. This procedure allows voters to remove and replace a public official before the end of their term of office. question: The current Secretary-General of the United Nations is_________
explanation: As of 2019, Antonio Guterres, a Portuguese diplomat was the ninth serving Secretary-General of the United Nations. He assumed office on January 1, 2017, succeeding Ban Ki-moon. Antonio Guterres is a Portuguese politician and diplomat who previously served as the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees from 2005 to 2015. His extensive experience in international relations and commitment to addressing global challenges have been central to his role as the Secretary-General.
